risks.risk: Whether the alternator functions or has been tested
risks.proof: Video of a bench test showing output voltage and the pulley spinning freely

risks.risk: Age or mileage of the unit
risks.proof: Clear photo of any manufacturing date label, part number stamp, or service receipt
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown-age unit with maximum expected wear

risks.proof: Photo of the alternator label or part number matched to a fitment guide
risks.if_unproven: Priced as fitment-unknown; buyer may need to modify or resell

risks.proof: Screenshot or written statement of warranty period and return policy
risks.if_unproven: Priced as sold as-is with no returns

risks.risk: Condition of internal bearings and brushes
risks.proof: Close-up video of shaft play and brush wear, or a teardown photo of internals
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having worn bearings and brushes

proof_requests: Photo of label or part number for fitment
response.reason: The witness identified the item as a used car alternator, so a worst-case price is possible; unproven function, age, fitment, warranty, and internals are listed as risks with the proof needed to raise value.
